definition_zh: 扶壁；支撑物；支持（论点、主张等）
definition_en: a structure built against a wall to support it; as a verb, to support or strengthen an argument or system
core_image: 教堂外墙斜斜伸出的石臂，稳稳抵住高墙
scene: 哥特教堂外墙边，石臂一根根斜抵着高墙。Flying buttresses support the cathedral's towering wall.
sceneCN: 这里 buttress 是「扶壁、支撑结构」（第 1 个义项：抵住墙体的支撑构件）；句意为飞扶壁支撑着大教堂的高墙。

pos.zh: 支撑；加固；为（论点）提供支持

derivatives.zh: 由过去分词转形容词，义为「有扶壁支撑的；有据可依的」
由动词加 -ing 转名词，义为「支撑作用；扶壁修建」

senses.title: A structure supporting a wall
senses.definition: a projecting structure of stone or brick built against a wall to strengthen it
senses.definitionCN: 砌在墙外侧、用来加固墙体的凸出结构
senses.example: The old church leans slightly against its massive buttresses.
senses.exampleCN: 老教堂微微倚在粗大的扶壁上。
senses.why: The root means to push or strike; the buttress is the thing that pushes back against the wall.
senses.whyCN: 词根本义「推撞」，扶壁正是反向推住墙的那股力。

senses.title: Anything giving firm support
senses.definition: a person or thing that gives firm support to something, as traditions to a society
senses.definitionCN: 给某物以坚实支持的人或事物，如支撑社会的传统
senses.example: Rural custom was a buttress of the old order.
senses.exampleCN: 乡村习俗是旧秩序的一根支柱。
senses.why: The mason's prop becomes a metaphor for any load-bearing element.
senses.whyCN: 石匠的支撑物被借作任何承重因素的比喻。

senses.title: To support or strengthen (verb)
senses.definition: to make stronger by adding support, literally or figuratively
senses.definitionCN: 以支撑加固，实际或比喻义均可
senses.example: New evidence buttressed the scientist's claim.
senses.exampleCN: 新证据为这位科学家的主张提供了支撑。
senses.why: The noun turns into a verb: to act as a buttress for something.
senses.whyCN: 名词转动词：为某物充当扶壁。

intro.en: Buttress grew from the same Germanic pushing root as butt, through Old French bouterez.
intro.cn: buttress 与 butt 同出日耳曼「推撞」词根，经古法语 bouterez 而来。

items.en: a root meaning to strike or push entered Old French as boter.
items.cn: 表示「击打、推撞」的日耳曼词根进入古法语 boter。

items.en: bouterez or ars bouterez named a pushing support, literally a thrusting stone.
items.cn: 古法语 bouterez（ars bouterez，「推击之术」）指以推力支撑的构件。

items.en: buttress entered English with Gothic architecture.
items.cn: 十四世纪 buttress 随哥特式建筑进入英语。

items.en: the verb sense of supporting arguments appeared in learned prose.
items.cn: 十六世纪「支撑论点」的动词义见于书面语。

items.en: flying buttress is the famous Gothic form; the figurative use is now the more common one.
items.cn: 飞扶壁是哥特建筑的名件；如今比喻用法更为常用。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the pushing root; the near-meaning group gathers other supports.
note.cn: 形近组同出「推撞」词根；近义组是其他支撑类词。

entries.definition: to strike with the head; the pushing base of buttress
entries.definitionCN: 顶撞，buttress 词源的推撞基础

entries.definition: to join or lean against at an end

entries.definitionCN: 纽扣；圆头，同出日耳曼词根

entries.definition: a food spread, unrelated in origin
entries.definitionCN: 黄油，仅拼写相近，词源无关

entries.definition: a stick or object used as support
an upright column supporting a building
to strengthen with a supporting device
to support from below, literally or figuratively

normalIntro.en: Remember the push: the buttress is the wall's teammate, pushing back against the roof's weight.
normalIntro.cn: 记住「推」：扶壁是墙的队友，反向抵住屋顶的重量。

normal.en: The root butt means to push or strike.
normal.cn: 词根 butt 意为推、撞。

normal.en: A flying buttress arches over to reach the wall.
normal.cn: 飞扶壁以拱券跨过到达墙体。

normal.en: Buttress an argument is the standard figurative use.
normal.cn: buttress an argument 是标准比喻用法。

normal.en: Buttressed evidence is evidence with support.
normal.cn: buttressed evidence 指有支撑的证据。

normal.en: Butter and buttress are not related.
normal.cn: butter 与 buttress 词源无关。

abstract.en: Feel the cool stone of a buttress against your palm.
abstract.cn: 感受扶壁石料的凉意贴在掌心。

abstract.en: See an argument stand up straight as each fact is added.
abstract.cn: 看论点随着每条事实的加入而挺立起来。

abstract.en: Picture a leaning bookcase saved by one wedged plank.
abstract.cn: 想象一块斜楔的木板救下一座倾倒的书架。

examples.en: Engineers added steel buttresses to the cracked wall.
examples.cn: 工程师给开裂的墙加装了钢制撑架。

examples.en: The report was buttressed by decades of field data.
examples.cn: 这份报告有数十年的实地数据作支撑。

examples.en: Gothic cathedrals could not stand without their flying buttresses.
examples.cn: 哥特大教堂没有飞扶壁就无法矗立。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「巴特瑞斯」——像「巴特」一样爱顶牛的「瑞斯」，天天用肩膀顶住高墙。

root: buttress 源自日耳曼「推撞」词根（与 butt、button 同源），经古法语 bouterez「推撑之石」进入英语；本指反向顶住墙体的构件，后兼作动词，指对论点、制度等的支撑。

sensesIntro.en: A pushing stone against a wall becomes, by metaphor, every firm support and the act of supporting.
sensesIntro.cn: 一块抵墙的推石，经比喻化为一切坚实支撑及支撑这一行为。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a stone arm leaning against a tall wall.
core.cn: 核心意象：一条抵住高墙的石臂。

branches.en: a stone buttress against the gale
custom as a buttress of the old order
branches.cn: 作为旧秩序支柱的习俗

branches.en: same push in stone and in argument
branches.cn: 石与论证中同样的推力

intro.en: Buttress ends with the French noun ending -ess added to the pushing root.
intro.cn: buttress 在「推撞」词根后加了法语名词词尾 -ess。

latinIntro.en: No Latin stem; the family runs through Germanic and Old French.
latinIntro.cn: 无拉丁词干；词族经日耳曼语与古法语流传。

items.meaning: to support like a long cushion
